name: agent-feedback
title: Agent Feedback
description: Record narrated UI feedback and copy local, agent-ready context.
author: vojtaholik

commands.name: toggle-recording
commands.title: Record Agent Feedback
commands.subtitle: Ready to Record
commands.description: Toggle screen and microphone recording, then copy an agent-ready report.

commands.name: mark-moment
commands.title: Mark Feedback Moment
commands.description: Add a timestamped screenshot to the active feedback recording.

commands.name: download-model
commands.title: Download Local Whisper Model
commands.description: Download the multilingual Whisper base model for fully local transcription.

commands.name: open-sessions
commands.title: Open Feedback Sessions
commands.description: Open the local folder containing recordings, transcripts, screenshots, and reports.

preferences.name: whisperModelPath
preferences.title: Whisper Model Path
preferences.description: Optional path to an existing whisper.cpp .bin model. Leave empty to use the model downloaded by this extension.

preferences.name: whisperCliPath
preferences.title: Whisper CLI Path
preferences.description: Optional path to whisper-cli. Homebrew installations on Apple silicon and Intel are detected automatically.

preferences.name: language
preferences.title: Spoken Language
preferences.description: Whisper language code such as en or cs, or auto.

preferences.name: displayNumber
preferences.title: Display Number
preferences.description: 1 records the main display; use 2 or higher for another display.

preferences.name: maxFrames
preferences.title: Maximum Automatic Frames
preferences.description: Maximum screenshots included when no moments were marked manually.
